<a href="https://www.nmbu.no/en/research/groups/tetra-ai" target="_blank" style="font-weight:600;color:#1a3a5c;">Trustworthy and Efficient Transfer Learning AI (TETRA AI)</a> — a research group at NMBU dedicated to advancing methods that make AI models both trustworthy and highly efficient. Research focuses on zero/few-shot learning, neural-symbolic reasoning, and lightweight architectures for real-world deployment across healthcare, agriculture, energy, and automotive systems.
</p>

];

const CATS = {
  all:       "All",
  active:    "Active Projects",
  completed: "Completed Projects",
  collab:    "Collaborations"
};

const CBADGE = {
  active:    "background:#E1F5EE;color:#085041",
  completed: "background:#f1efe8;color:#444441",
  collab:    "background:#EEEDFE;color:#3C3489"
};

let activeCat = "all";

function render() {
  const filtered = PROJECTS.filter(i => activeCat === "all" || i.cat === activeCat);

  const filters = Object.entries(CATS).map(([k,v]) => {
    const on = activeCat === k;
    const style = on
      ? "background:#1a3a5c;color:white;border-color:#1a3a5c;"
      : "background:white;color:#6c757d;border-color:#dde4ed;";
    const count = k === "all" ? PROJECTS.length : PROJECTS.filter(i=>i.cat===k).length;
    return `<span onclick="setCat('${k}')" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid;cursor:pointer;${style}">${v} <span style="opacity:0.7">(${count})</span></span>`;
  }).join("");

  const items = filtered.map(i => {
    const badge = `<span style="font-size:9px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:600;margin-right:6px;${CBADGE[i.cat]}">${CATS[i.cat]}</span>`;
    const link = i.url ? `<a href="${i.url}" target="_blank" style="font-size:0.82rem;color:#2d7dd2;">More info →</a>` : "";
    return `<div style="background:white;border:1px solid #dde4ed;border-radius:8px;padding:1.1rem 1.25rem;margin-bottom:0.75rem;">
      <div style="font-size:0.78rem;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:4px;">${badge}<strong style="color:#2d7dd2;">${i.role}</strong> · <span style="font-style:italic;">${i.funder}</span></div>
      <div style="font-size:0.95rem;font-weight:600;color:#1a3a5c;margin-bottom:5px;">${i.title}</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#6c757d;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:4px;">${i.desc}</div>
      ${link}
    </div>`;
  }).join("");

  document.getElementById("research-app").innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:20px;">${filters}</div>
    <div style="font-size:12px;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:12px;">Showing <strong>${filtered.length}</strong> of <strong>${PROJECTS.length}</strong> entries</div>
    ${items}
  `;
}

function setCat(cat) { activeCat = cat; render(); }
render();
</script>
